consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance at the Fox Theater on April 10, 1978, had its ups and downs, with some standout moments, particularly in the second set. While there were some technical issues and moments of disarray, the overall vibe and energy of the show, especially during 'Franklin's Tower,' left a positive impression on many attendees.
